args.title: Bellwether Office: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the latest Bellwether Office newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Newsletter: This week's edition covers cold-chain logistics in 2026 and links to the feature article at blog.bellwether.example.
• Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
